name: GitHub Actions
author: Poni
description: Builds and deploys from GitHub Actions beside the notch while they run, green or red when they finish.

settings.label: GitHub token
settings.help: A fine-grained token with read-only access to Actions and Deployments for these repositories. Needed for private ones; public ones work without it but are limited to 60 checks an hour. Saved in Poni's settings on this Mac and only sent to api.github.com.

id.description: Build dan deploy dari GitHub Actions di samping notch selama berjalan, hijau atau merah saat selesai.

token.label: Token GitHub
token.help: Token fine-grained dengan akses baca-saja ke Actions dan Deployments untuk repositori ini. Wajib untuk repositori privat; repositori publik bisa tanpa token tapi dibatasi 60 pengecekan per jam. Disimpan di pengaturan Poni di Mac ini dan hanya dikirim ke api.github.com.
